name: hecks-lsp-client
description: Diagnostics, outline, and go-to-definition for .bluebook/.hecksagon files, via rust/lsp's hecks-lsp

hecks.lsp.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the hecks-lsp binary (rust/lsp). Leave empty to search $PATH, then rust/lsp/target/{debug,release}/hecks-lsp relative to the first workspace folder.

hecks.parse.binaryPath.description: Absolute path to the hecks-parse binary (rust/parser), passed to hecks-lsp as HECKS_PARSE_BIN. Leave empty to let hecks-lsp locate it itself — see rust/lsp/README.md's own lookup order.
